thread:
jamie: FYI PR #14233 is blocked by CI — nightly-kv-e2e shard5 keeps failing on macOS only. I reproduced locally once. Asking for a quick decision: mark test as quarantined so we can merge the infra fix, or do a targeted rerun?
ajamie: repro snippet from my run:
```
FAIL tests/e2e/kv_shard5_test.go:238 - timeout waiting for kv open on macOS-12
--- logs ---
2024-08-21T02:13:45Z ERROR connection: dial timeout
2024-08-21T02:14:12Z WARN shard5: recoverable error
```
ci-bot: CI failed for PR 14233 (nightly-kv-e2e / shard5 macOS). Flaky detection: 3 fails in last 24h. Suggested action: targeted rerun or quarantine. Use `/ci` commands.
avery: thanks for the context — what's the risk of quarantining? will it conceal a regression?
jamie: good question. This test has had intermittent macOS issues for ~2 weeks, unrelated traces in logs look like network timeouts to stubbed service. infra fix in this PR reduces concurrency which should stabilize it.
priya: can we do a targeted rerun first? if it passes we can merge and follow up with a quarantine after one more fail. I don't want to quarantine before we confirm.
lina: re: targeted rerun: buildkite sometimes queues long. We can kick a quick targeted run for shard5 only. /ci rerun --pr=14233 --shard=5 --targeted
ci-bot: Command received: `/ci rerun --pr=14233 --shard=5 --targeted` — queued targeted job on runner macos-shard5 (approx ETA 6m).
tony: pinging oncall to bump priority if it stays queued >10m.
avery: if the targeted run flakes again, I'd vote for temporary quarantine with a TODO to re-enable after root cause. We need the infra change in.
ci-bot: Targeted build started: https://ci.redwood/14233/build/5581 (macos-shard5).
(6 minutes later)
ci-bot: Build finished: macos-shard5 — FAILURE — runtime timeout same as before.
jamie: ok it failed again, same timeout. I'll open a short follow-up to quarantine the test and mention owners to re-enable after monitoring.
priya: please add a short description in the quarantine entry with repro steps and logs. Also set an auto-reminder in 2 weeks for re-eval.
lina: +1 for quarantine + auto-reminder. Also add a note that this only affects macOS shard5.
jamie: created quarantine MR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/test-quarantine/merge_requests/88 — includes metadata and 2-week reminder. CC @avery @priya for review.
avery: reviewing now. If it looks good I'll approve.
(5 minutes)
avery: Approved. :white_check_mark: go ahead to merge.
jamie: merging quarantine MR and then re-triggering CI for the main PR. Will follow up with a short post in #eng to track. Thanks all. :rocket:
